invite.title: Invitations
invite.subtitle: Invite people to sign up with a privileged role. The link works once and expires.
invite.rolesHelp: They get these roles as soon as they create their account.
invite.sentBody: The email is on its way. You can also copy the link and share it yourself. It is shown only now.

invite.resent: A new invitation link was sent
invite.revokeBody: The link sent to {{email}} stops working immediately.
invite.emptyBody: Invite a judge or another privileged user to get started.

priv.title: Roles and privileges
priv.subtitle: Tick what each role is allowed to do. Changes apply within a minute.
priv.fullAccessNote: Super Admin and DMD always have every privilege.
priv.scopeNote: These privileges control idea triage and decisions, pilot approval, impact verification and the permission checks in the app. Which menus a role sees comes from the role itself.

account.deactivateBody: They are signed out and can't sign in until the account is activated again. Their work is kept.
